# Stage: AFTER (Plan 18 Indexes Installed)
# Spec: munin-pr0 PR-0 performance regression benchmark

# Query: list_conversations
# SQL: SELECT c.id, c.title FROM conversations c JOIN conversation_participants p ON p.conversation_id = c.id WHERE p.user_id = ? AND p.removed_at_ms IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_activity_at_ms DESC
SEARCH p USING INDEX idx_conversation_participants_user (user_id=? AND removed_at_ms=?)
SEARCH c USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_conversations_1 (id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

# Query: get_run_detail_reasoning_events
# SQL: SELECT * FROM reasoning_events WHERE run_id = ?
SEARCH reasoning_events USING INDEX idx_reasoning_events_run (run_id=?)

# Query: get_run_detail_tool_calls
# SQL: SELECT * FROM tool_calls WHERE run_id = ?
SEARCH tool_calls USING INDEX idx_tool_calls_run (run_id=?)

# Query: get_run_detail_subagent_runs
# SQL: SELECT * FROM subagent_runs WHERE parent_run_id = ?
SEARCH subagent_runs USING INDEX idx_subagent_runs_parent (parent_run_id=?)

# Query: get_run_detail_human_requests
# SQL: SELECT * FROM human_requests WHERE run_id = ?
SEARCH human_requests USING INDEX idx_human_requests_run (run_id=?)

# Query: get_run_detail_conversation_artifacts
# SQL: SELECT * FROM conversation_artifacts WHERE run_id = ?
SEARCH conversation_artifacts USING INDEX idx_conversation_artifacts_run (run_id=?)

# Query: agent_runs_by_conversation
# SQL: SELECT * FROM agent_runs WHERE conversation_id = ?
SEARCH agent_runs USING INDEX idx_agent_runs_conversation (conversation_id=?)

# Query: conversation_summaries_by_conv
# SQL: SELECT * FROM conversation_summaries WHERE conversation_id = ?
SEARCH conversation_summaries USING INDEX idx_conversation_summaries_conv (conversation_id=?)
